note: Only controller, geometry and inference observations are vendored; no PPO, critic, reward or curriculum runtime. Legacy C58 remains separate.

deployment_adaptations.input: External Space/WASD/QE/arrow commands replace training scenario scheduler; no automatic rise/land.
deployment_adaptations.history: Same first-frame replication and oldest-first order; cleared at every accepted rise.
deployment_adaptations.timing: 2ms native source physics,15 substeps per30ms policy sample.
deployment_adaptations.handoff: LAND unchanged. At confirmed ground HANDOFF entry, live operator input immediately owns the ordinary command while pinned executed wheel targets blend over existing0.3s; hip0/ground confirmation do not defer input. No extra blend at success. EXIT uses the same pinned blend and live input.
deployment_adaptations.safety: Independent MuJoCo body-contact/height guard exits call without adding contact to actor observations.
deployment_adaptations.ordinary: Source full wheel/hip targets independent of policy motion limits; trained source controller retained.
